name: release-version-alignment
description: Fast path for Helm version alignment check before release tagging

allowed_operations: minimal PR creation for missing alignment

issue_reference.auto_close_only_when: user explicitly requests auto-close after merge

branch_cleanliness.clean_branch_required_when: unrelated commits exist or working tree has non-helm changes

stop_and_ask_when: request mixes version alignment with other changes

checks: file scope: only 4 target helm files
version alignment: all version/appVersion/image.tag match target
diff sanity: no template or dependency changes
changelog: release.md contains entry for target version

gateway resource sync: if any docs/api/swagger/backend/api/v3/*.swagger.json file changed in the target version window and affects a gateway-visible contract, apigw/resources.yaml must also have been updated in that version window

output_format.pr_title: feat: bump helm release version to {version} --issue=#{issue-number}
